purpose: Coordinate multiple safety, dependability, consequence, cyber, ecological and mission-assurance methods without collapsing them into one score or transferring child-domain authority.

methods.purpose: Identify failure modes, causes and local/system effects at item/process/interface level.
limits: bottom-up; may miss emergent/control-interaction hazards
RPN is prioritisation aid, not universal acceptability criterion

methods.purpose: Extend FMEA with consequence criticality prioritisation.
limits: criticality model must be declared and evidence-bounded

methods.purpose: Identify hazards, hazardous states, controls and residual risk across system lifecycle.
limits: requires explicit system boundary and lifecycle phase
methods.reference: ECSS-Q-ST-40-02C / applicable jurisdictional safety process

methods.purpose: Systematic guide-word review of deviations from intended process/operability.
limits: best suited to process/operational flows with defined intent

methods.purpose: Top-down logical decomposition of causes contributing to a defined top event.
limits: top event and independence/common-cause assumptions must be explicit
methods.reference: IEC 61025 / ECSS-Q-ST-40-12C

methods.purpose: Forward event-sequence analysis after initiating events and protection successes/failures.
limits: branch probabilities require evidence and are not inferred by default

methods.purpose: Connect threats, top event, preventive controls, consequences and mitigative controls.
limits: barrier independence and performance must be verified
methods.reference: risk-technique / local procedure

methods.purpose: Analyse unsafe control actions and system-level causal scenarios in complex software/autonomous socio-technical systems.
limits: method model is not a compliance certificate and does not replace domain standards
methods.reference: MIT STPA method / domain safety process

methods.purpose: Estimate maximum probable third-party loss/insurance exposure where applicable to regulated space activity.
limits: not an engineering hazard probability
not mission-readiness proof
not legal determination
Australian estimator is not application evidence
methods.reference: Australian Space Agency Maximum Probable Loss Methodology (2019)

methods.purpose: Quantify likelihood/consequence where models and evidence justify numerical treatment.
limits: numerical output must expose uncertainty/model validity; no false precision
methods.reference: ISO 31000 + IEC 31010 method family / jurisdictional methods

methods.purpose: Define safety functions, integrity requirements, diagnostics, independence and safe states.
limits: domain-specific standard selection required
methods.reference: IEC 61508 / ISO 13849 / sector-specific standards

methods.purpose: Model threats, trust boundaries, compromise paths, privileges, recovery and supply-chain risk.
limits: cyber controls do not substitute for physical safety interlocks
methods.reference: NIST CSF 2.0 / IEC 62443 family

methods.purpose: Assess AI/model impacts, validity envelope, bias, human/agent oversight, drift and failover.
limits: model performance does not confer authority
methods.reference: ISO/IEC 42001; ISO/IEC 23894; ISO/IEC 42005; NIST AI RMF

methods.purpose: Assess organism/ecosystem health, movement, provenance, pathogen, invasive and cumulative ecological pathways.
limits: local ecology/provenance and jurisdiction govern; no universal species recipe
methods.reference: One Health + applicable biosecurity/environmental law + Eco-Grex evidence

methods.purpose: Assess generated-object identity, debris creation, conjunction, disposal, passivation and uncontrolled-reentry risk.
limits: nominal trajectory alone is insufficient
methods.reference: UNOOSA LTS Guidelines + applicable debris standard/regulation

methods.purpose: Assess forward/back contamination and protected-body/sample pathways.
limits: mission/body classification and current policy must be verified
methods.reference: COSPAR Planetary Protection Policy 2026 + applicable agency rules

methods.purpose: Assess loss of people, communications, power, suppliers, governance, keys and infrastructure with graceful degradation/restart.
limits: continuity cannot preserve unsafe production merely to preserve activity
methods.reference: business continuity / domain emergency procedures / CGX lifecycle controls

methods.purpose: Assess decommissioning, circularity, residual hazards, records and successor legibility.
limits: recycling is not automatically preferable to safe containment or reuse
methods.reference: ISO lifecycle/circularity families + CGP-IES

methods.purpose: Verify requirements, models, interfaces, tests, calibration, acceptance and evidence lineage.
limits: simulation validation does not equal physical validation outside tested envelope
methods.reference: systems/software lifecycle + domain qualification standards

methods.purpose: Maintain a bounded claim-argument-evidence-defeater structure for safety, security, dependability or other assurance properties.
limits: supported-within-scope is not certification, legal approval, residual-risk acceptance or execution authority
methods.reference: ISO/IEC/IEEE 15026-2:2022

methods.purpose: Assess goal hijack, tool misuse, privilege abuse, agentic supply chain, code execution, memory/context poisoning, inter-agent trust, cascade and rogue-agent risks.
limits: agent-security controls supplement rather than replace software safety, cybersecurity, functional safety or physical interlocks
methods.reference: OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications 2026 + MITRE ATLAS + applicable NIST/IEC controls

methods.purpose: Assess software contribution to hazards, safety-critical requirements, configuration/change control, unintended behaviour, verification and independent review through the software lifecycle.
limits: software test pass is not physical-system validation; applicable organisational/sector standards and independence requirements govern
methods.reference: NASA-STD-8739.8B as space-software applicability reference + applicable software/system safety standards

methods.purpose: Assess workload, fatigue, maintainability, access, warnings, controls, emergency interaction, foreseeable misuse and operator recovery.
limits: human-factors analysis is context-, population- and environment-specific and cannot be reduced to generic operator blame
methods.reference: InterSol human-factors corpus + applicable ergonomics, accessibility and domain safety requirements

methods.purpose: Evaluate whether independent protection layers provide sufficient risk reduction for a defined process-hazard scenario where the method is applicable and evidence supports quantification.
limits: protection-layer independence/performance must be justified; LOPA is scenario-specific and not a substitute for HAZOP, full QRA or functional-safety lifecycle
methods.reference: IEC 61511 process functional-safety family + IEC 31010 risk-assessment techniques

composition_rule: Select the smallest sufficient independent method bundle for the actual hazard/problem; add methods when consequence, uncertainty or cross-domain coupling warrants them. One method never silently certifies another method's question.
assurance_case_rule: A method result may support an assurance-case claim only within its declared configuration, evidence state and validity envelope; blocking defeaters force HOLD.
